item.text: Lint steps gain env and cwd; no setup or runner key is added. Evidence: config test rejects [tool.sc-lint].setup and [tool.sc-lint].runner as unknown keys.
item.title: ANC-012 pass fixture

item.text: Add [tool.sc-lint.runner].python so a leading 'python' in step argv resolves to the consumer venv interpreter.
item.title: ANC-012 fail fixture

cases.rationale: ANC-012 v2 approved fixtures.fail: adds an interpreter-selection key.

item.text: A [[tool.sc-lint.lint]] step in sc-lint.toml accepts an env table and a cwd key, applied to that step's child process. [tool.sc-lint].setup and [tool.sc-lint].runner stay rejected as unknown keys; no setup-hook or interpreter-selection key is added.
item.title: Lint-step env and cwd (#198)

cases.rationale: ANC-012 v2 scope: 'The item adds or changes consumer setup, hook or interpreter-selection configuration keys in sc-lint.toml.' Same shape as the pass fixture; INTENT #198: 'Lint steps accept env and cwd ... No setup hook or interpreter-selection key is added'.

item.text: A [[tool.sc-lint.lint]] step in sc-lint.toml accepts an env table and a cwd key, applied to that step's child process, with the same meaning they have on a test command selector.
item.title: Lint-step env and cwd

cases.rationale: ANC-012 v2 scope: 'The item adds or changes consumer setup, hook or interpreter-selection configuration keys in sc-lint.toml.' Changes consumer step configuration keys (pass-fixture subject) without stating the prohibition; silence is not conflict.

item.text: A [[tool.sc-lint.lint]] step accepts env = { PYO3_PYTHON = ".venv/bin/python" }; sc-lint passes the value to the child verbatim and does not resolve or select an interpreter. No setup or runner key is added; both stay rejected.
item.title: Lint-step env passes PYO3_PYTHON verbatim

cases.rationale: ANC-012 v2 scope: 'The item adds or changes consumer setup, hook or interpreter-selection configuration keys in sc-lint.toml.' An env value is consumer data handed to the child, not a sc-lint interpreter-selection key; INTENT #198 and ADR-022 decision 6.

item.text: Add [tool.sc-lint].setup.pre, a list of commands that sc-lint runs before the first lint step, so consumers can create their Python venv.
item.title: Consumer setup hook

cases.rationale: ANC-012 v2 statement names [tool.sc-lint].setup.pre as a forbidden setup-hook key.

item.text: A [[tool.sc-lint.lint]] step gains a python key; sc-lint runs the step's argv with that interpreter instead of the one on PATH.
item.title: Per-step interpreter key

cases.rationale: ANC-012 v2 forbids an interpreter-selection configuration key; INTENT out of scope: 'interpreter selection'.

item.text: A [[tool.sc-lint.lint]] step gains a before key holding a command that sc-lint runs before that step's child process starts.
item.title: Per-step pre-run hook

cases.rationale: ANC-012 v2 forbids a setup-hook configuration key; INTENT out of scope: 'setup hooks'.
